snippet.title: KICK-BELL - SAGE 2025 Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Kick-Bell is making its debut at SAGE this year! Try out the demo by yourself, or with up to 3 other people locally!

The Sage demo features:

19 stages (two areas featured in KICK-BELL)
1 boss
4-Player Couch Co-Op

OVERVIEW:

KICK-BELL is a 4 player, 3D-action arcade styled game where you must defeat every enemy to proceed to the next stage.

Stages work like puzzles! Line up enemies to increase your combo for better collectables! The better the collectables, the higher your score will increase!

Depending on the stage, you will also need to take in the stages colors to see what layer of the stage you are on. Matching the colors of the floor and walls will help you get a sense of depth in the stages!

Work together as a team with up to 4 players! Each player has their own set of lives, however your score is shared with one another. The more lives each player has by the end of an area, the more your score will raise in the final count up!

FOLLOW THE GAME HERE: https://gamejolt.com/games/KickBell/1018677
